verdict.rationale: There is direct evidence of MCP compatibility documentation (anythingllm-probe-3) indicating AnythingLLM can integrate MCP servers as tools for its agents, consistent with its agent-skill framework (anythingllm-docs-12). However, no independent/community corroboration or detailed docs on setup, configuration, or real-world usage of MCP servers were provided. Missing for 10: hands-on/community validation of MCP server usage, detailed configuration docs, and confirmation of tool invocation reliability.
